name: ripple-button
title: Ripple Button
description: An animated button with ripple useful for user engagement.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { RippleButton } from '@/components/ui/ripple-button'
</script>

<template>
  <RippleButton ripple-color="#ADD8E6" @click="console.log('clicked')">Click me</RippleButton>
</template>

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one ripple, e.g. `600ms` or `1s`.

emits.name: click
emits.description: Fired on click, after the ripple is spawned.
